Standard: The air vehicle emitting equipment does not interfere with the performance or operation of targeted air vehicle systems or other systems installed on the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Electromagnetic environmental effects analysis of emitting equipment verifies emitting equipment, that is powered on during AR operations, does not interfere with targeted air vehicle or other systems installed on the air vehicle. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Laboratory testing of air vehicle emitting equipment verifies spectral characteristics which support E3 analyses.
